title: Correlated randomness in Slay the Spire 2
summary: This article explores the game design concept of correlated randomness in Slay the Spire 2, examining how roguelike deck-building games manipulate probability to create fairer and more engaging gameplay experiences by ensuring random events aren't truly independent.
problem_solved: How to make random outcomes in games feel fair and satisfying rather than frustrating or arbitrary.
why_valuable: Understanding correlated randomness helps game designers create more polished and enjoyable gameplay by subtly guiding probability distributions to prevent streak-based frustration.
